scope: LCS5 (End-of-Life) – Circular Footprint Formula defaults for Apparel & Footwear

method_defaults.A_factor_reference: Defined by pathway/material per PEFCR. See A_factor_selection_rules.

mechanical_wipers.Ev_scope: Production of wipers from virgin cotton
mechanical_wipers.Erec_scope: Collection, sorting, clothes preparation for recycling and production of wipers from used clothes

mechanical_insulation.Erec_scope: Collection, sorting, clothes preparation for recycling and production of insulation from used clothes

mechanical_textile_to_textile.Erec_scope: Collection, sorting, clothes preparation for recycling and production of recycled fibres through mechanical recycling

chemical_textile_to_textile_synthetics.Erec_scope: Collection, sorting, clothes preparation for recycling and production of recycled fibres through chemical recycling

chemical_textile_to_textile_manmade_cell.Erec_scope: Collection, sorting, clothes preparation for recycling and production of recycled fibres through chemical recycling

thermoplastic_material.Erec_scope: Collection, sorting, preparation of shoes for recycling, grinding and extrusion

reticulated_materials_PU_foam.Ev_scope: PU foam and other reticulated materials
reticulated_materials_PU_foam.Erec_scope: Collection, sorting, preparation of shoes for recycling, recycling process

recyclability_disruptors_note: Where recyclability disruptors apply (see Tables 24–26), set R2 for the affected pathway to 0 for that product.
